report: Two months of chest pain and dyspnea with right hemithoracic dullness suggested a right thoracic process. Imaging showed a 20.8×13.6×13 cm heterogeneous pleural-based mass with fat/calcification and atelectasis. Biopsy revealed myxoid tissue, atypical cells, lipoblasts, S100 positivity and Alcian blue-positive mucin; the pathologist favors myxoid liposarcoma, the gold standard for tumor nature, refuting empyema and primary lung disease. Molecular, PET/MRI and LDH data are lacking, leaving subtype, grade and staging unconfirmed.
